provenance.source_course: Bazaar Art · ART101 / Foundations of Visual Art
provenance.migration: non-destructive clone and adaptation into ARTS-111

course.title: Drawing, Observation & Creative Calling
course.monday_design_rule: Every Monday is Creative Day: one major weekly theme, inspiration, accessible art skill, focused studio project, evidence and reflection.
course.implementation_note: Weeks 01–36 now have Monday–Friday Higher Learning lesson paths. Weeks 01–26 remain grounded in implemented Bazaar ART101 source lessons; Weeks 27–36 are authored Higher Learning implementations of the approved ART101 continuation map and are not represented as pre-existing full Bazaar lessons.
